_boardGuide: STATE BOARD: update this file after each event. This is a manual ledger, not a live scoreboard. Never write a script that auto-generates these totals from another system. After an Innovation Challenge, Policy Cup, or Research Symposium: record ONE result per chapter per year (participation, top10, top3, or win). Those three events have no Regional/State/National ladder. After a Nationals round: ADD a line item to that year's nationals array as the team advances (regionalParticipation, then regionalToState, and so on). Do not replace the Nationals array with a single placement the way you do for the other three. After an Apex: start a new cycle. Change the cycle string, reset every chapter year1/year2 results and tie-breakers to empty/zero. NEVER edit pointSchedule.oneTime or pointSchedule.nationalsLadder unless the board is deliberately changing the rules for a new cycle.
_note: Updated manually by the state chapter board after each event. Do not auto-generate. Keys in chapters must match ids in data/chapters.json (a school chapter id, or a state id until school chapters exist). Do not invent live school names here.
_recordingReminder: Innovation Challenge, Policy Cup, and Research Symposium are one-time events: one result per team per year. Nationals is a ladder: add climb line items as the team advances (regionalParticipation, regionalToState, stateTop3, stateToNational, nationalCompete). At the national finish, record only ONE of nationalTop10, nationalTop3, or nationalWin. Those do not stack. A full sweep is 230 points.
